chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: fighting stance subtle breathing, facing right

punch.action: right facing straight punch: guard, windup, fully extended horizontal fist to right, recovery

kick.action: right facing high side kick: windup, chamber bent knee, fully extended leg to right at chest level, recovery

hurt.action: hit reaction staggering backward, grimace, recoil, return guard

jump.action: jump poses: crouched takeoff, rising bent knees, airborne bent knees, landing

special.action: energy blast casting: windup arms, gather fists at hip, push both palms fully extended to right, recovery. no detached visual effects

walk.action: right facing fighting shuffle cycle: left foot advances, weight settles, right foot advances, return step. Keep both fists in guard. Clear alternating foot contacts, consistent proportions and height.

block.action: right facing high defensive block: guard, lift both forearms protecting face and torso, braced compact defensive posture, remain braced. Both feet stay planted.

crouch.action: right facing crouching guard: lower knees, squat deeper, compact low fighting guard, hold squat guard. Anatomical bent legs, no disappearing feet.

ko.action: right facing knockout fall: recoil backwards, knees buckle, fall sideways to ground, lie defeated horizontally on ground. Last pose low horizontal full body; no decapitation, no blood.

celebrate.action: victory celebration: idle guard, relaxed proud stance, one raised clenched fist triumph, hold raised fist with confident smile. Preserve costume and full body.

style: match the attached base/anchor reference image EXACTLY: same pixel density (logical pixel block size), same body proportions, same outline weight, same palette, same shading style, same level of detail. Do not restyle, do not change proportions, do not add or remove detail density.
